preconditions.description: n is an integer between 4 and 1000, inclusive, and is a multiple of 4.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < n**2 for row in return_value for x in row)
postconditions.description: All integers in the grid are between 0 and n^2 - 1, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: The grid is an n x n matrix.

postconditions.expression: len(set(x for row in return_value for x in row)) == n**2
postconditions.description: All integers from 0 to n^2 - 1 appear exactly once in the grid.

postconditions.expression: all(all(row[i] ^ row[j] for j in range(n) if i != j) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements in each row is the same.

postconditions.expression: all(all(return_value[i][j] ^ return_value[k][j] for k in range(n) if i != k) for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements in each column is the same.
